newsitem.title: USA: SI in talks with possible acquisition candidates.
newsitem.headline: SI in talks with possible acquisition candidates.

text.p: SI Technologies Inc said Monday its board authorized management to move forward aggressively in negotiations which are currently underway with a number of potential acquisition candidates.

"We are currently negotiating with several companies which represent strategic acquisition opportunities for our company, and management is optimistic that one or more of these transactions can be successfully concluded in the near future," said SI Technologies Chief Executive Rick Beets.
SI Technologies, which manufactures and markets mobile and stationary weighing systems, fleet information systems and force measurement devices, did not identify any specific acquisition candidates.
